title: Renewable Energy
meta_description: Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization.

blocks.x: The contract behind Renewable Energy: signed baseline in week two, working slice by week eight, industrialized controls by week twelve, and evidence flowing to your control owner throughout.
Before proposing anything, we map the context Renewable Energy will run in — regulators, decision cadence, existing contracts — because the design that ignores context fails at the gate.

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Renewable Energy
blocks.note: Contracts between stages are enforced at the boundary, so schema drift fails loudly in minutes instead of quietly in a quarter.

blocks.x: Every component in Renewable Energy has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

items: Fleet health reactive is where programs like this usually start: unglamorous, measurable and worth more than the technology conversation it replaces.
When Forecast precision short is the pain, the baseline audit usually confirms it is structural, not personal — the fix is designed for the system, not the people.
O&M planning manual costs real money every quarter it goes unmeasured; the first two weeks of the engagement exist to price it honestly.

We treat ESG evidence thin as a symptom with a cause — the diagnosis traces it to the decision or the contract that produces it.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
Tested, documented models with lineage exposure — the transform layer your analysts can actually read.
Every critical asset with a health score, an owner and a maintenance decision attached.
Interval readings cleaned, validated and staged for settlement-grade accuracy.
Forecast inputs joined to actuals so planners see where the forecast lied.
Grid operations integrated read-only — control stays deterministic, decisions get smarter.
Up 97–98.9% of tables inside their declared window on the first working slice; deeper scope moves it further
Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.
Batch windows measured against the plan every run — the number reported is the observed one.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Contracts enforced at the boundary — schema drift fails the pipeline loudly, in minutes.
Unit costs on a published budget with alerts at the threshold — creep is caught by the meter, not by the invoice.
One definition per metric, owned and versioned — the dashboard and the board pack cannot disagree.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: From sensor data to actuation — industrial IoT fabrics, twins and vision that close the loop.
Pipelines, governance and products on a lakehouse contract — reports that reconcile, lineage you can trace.
Digital workers with roles, budgets and human checkpoints — every action logged and reversible.
Permissioned networks, credentials and provenance — digital trust regulators can inspect.
Reliable estates at lower unit cost — hybrid multicloud, edge fleets and SRE discipline.

blocks.x: An engagement on Renewable Energy starts with a two-week baseline audit, runs a bounded pilot against a control group, and reaches its first gate with measured deltas — before any scale decision is made.

items: Forecast error is part of the steering pack from week two: current value, signed baseline and the delta since the last gate, on one line.
O&M cost/MW has a named owner and a fortnightly reading; the gate review compares it to the signed baseline, not to a promise.
Settlement disputes moves first here — the gate reviews the measured delta against the signed baseline before any scope expands
The committed move on this metric: down 31, measured against the baseline signed in week two
The measured delta and the method note are written up on the case page — anonymized by agreement, baseline audited.
